validation_rules.V1: Schema: every file has exactly the required columns (compatible structure for one batch).
validation_rules.V2: Types: distance, weight and minutes are present and numeric after ST3 text cleaning.
validation_rules.V3: Period: every request_date is a valid date inside the period stated in the file name.
validation_rules.V4: Key: delivery_id is filled and unique across the whole batch after exact duplicates are removed.
validation_rules.V5: Quality: business-invalid rows (<= 0 values) are at most 10% of a file.
validation_rules.V6: Consistency: final cost = base + distance + weight + zone fee and zones match the ST2 thresholds.
